payout_value_note: Flat $25 cash to the referrer per new-member account referral. No cap stated.
payout_quote: Refer your friends and family to become members of Southwest Oklahoma Federal Credit Union and you'll receive $25 cash! ... when they open an account* with us we'll deposit $25 into your account.
steps: Give a referral card to a friend or family member, or simply have them mention your name when they open their account (cards not required).
The referred person must qualify for membership; all parties must be 18+; accounts in good standing.
$25 cash deposited to the referrer's account after 30 days of the account opening.
catches: All parties must be 18+; accounts must be in good standing.
Cash deposited after 30 days of account opening — not immediate.
SWOFCU may withdraw the offer at any time; referral value may be subject to income-tax reporting.
SWOFCU may disqualify referrals it reasonably believes were not sent in good faith.
biggest_catch: Only $25 per referral, and the cash isn't deposited until 30 days after the new account is opened.
eligibility: SWOFCU members; referred person must qualify for membership.
timing: Referral handoff ~5 min active; $25 deposited after 30 days of account opening.
